sentences.text:
For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Akash Ranjan
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Tarun Prasad Mandal

= =========================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice S. B. Pd. Singh
 Oral Order
3 07-11-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner as well as learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Pandaul P.S. Case No. 64 of 2025 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120(B) of the Indian Penal Code.
3. As per the prosecution case, the petitioner secured appointment in the teacher recruitment process by using a forged training certificate and marks-sheet.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is quite innocent and has falsely been implicated in the present case.

As a matter of fact no occurrence as alleged by the prosecution has taken place, and the petitioner at the time of his appointment has supplied all his documents Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.49085 of 2025(3) dt.07-11-2025 believing them to be genuine and after due verification the appointment letter was issued to him and since then he was discharging his duty as teacher diligently.

Learned counsel for the petitioner in para 4 of the supplementary affidavit has stated that petitioner has been terminated from his post and that document has been brought on record vide Annexure-P/3.
Learned counsel further submits that petitioner has no criminal antecedent.
5. Learned A.P.P. for the State has vehemently opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner.

entities.text: Vidyanand Singh vs The State Of Bihar on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, let the above named petitioner, in the event of his arrest/surrender within a period of six weeks from today, be enlarged on anticipatory bail on furnishing bail-bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Madhubani in connection with G.R. No. 624 of 2025 arising out of Pandaul P.S. Case No. 64 of 2025, subject to conditions as laid down under section 482(2) of the B.N.S.S, with further condition:-
(i) Petitioner shall co-operate in the trial and shall be present on each and every fixed date till framing of charge and Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.49085 of 2025(3)
dt.07-11-2025 on his absence on two consecutive dates without sufficient reason, his bail bonds may be cancelled by the learned trial court.
(S. B. Pd. Singh, J) amitkr/-
